purpose: Behavior-preserving instrumentation: historical output and selected attempt parity, unchanged-code rerun RNG parity, newly observable search accounting. No wordlikeness improvement is claimed.
fingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(generator.sources), containing sorted source paths and complete source text. Candidate measurements include uncommitted changes; the base commit is not the complete source identity.

originalArchive.scope: First 1,000 draws of each of 20 original development streams; full run integrity verified with readRun(directory, true) before reading archives.
originalArchive.sourceDigestMethod: Quality-baseline canonical fingerprint, distinct from the rejection probe source fingerprint.

comparisonUnits.proposedLengths: All attempts, marginalized over morphologyPhonemes when comparing the first three dimensions.
comparisonUnits.strata: Actual morphology template and returned-word syllable count; proposed candidates are grouped by the final returned result, not their own syllable-count strata.
